name: Bio Essence Corporation
summary: Bio Essence Corporation is a global enterprise specializing in herbal health, dietary, and nutritional solutions. It supplies healthcare professionals with a diverse range of herbal remedies, offered in various forms such as granules, capsules, pills, and tablets. Furthermore, the company extends custom formulation and original equipment manufacturing (OEM) services to these practitioners and manufactures and distributes its own line of health supplements. Founded in 2000, Bio Essence Corporation maintains its corporate headquarters in Irvine, California.
